public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let sorted_steps be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let empty_steps: List of Text be []

  for each known_step in sorted_steps
    let required_steps be dependencies.get(known_step) otherwise crash with "known step was missing: {known_step}"
    for each required_step in required_steps
      if not dependencies.contains_key(required_step) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: known_step, depends_on: required_step)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable ordered_steps be empty_steps
  let mutable remaining_steps be sorted_steps

  repeat until remaining_steps.is_empty
    let mutable ready_steps be empty_steps

    for each candidate_step in remaining_steps
      let candidate_dependencies be dependencies.get(candidate_step) otherwise crash with "candidate step was missing: {candidate_step}"
      let candidate_is_ready be for each blocking_step in candidate_dependencies all ordered_steps.contains(blocking_step)
      if candidate_is_ready then
        set ready_steps to ready_steps.append(candidate_step)
      end
    end

    if ready_steps.is_empty then
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining_steps)
    end

    set ordered_steps to ordered_steps.append_all(ready_steps)

    let next_remaining_steps be
      for each remaining_candidate in remaining_steps
      where not ready_steps.contains(remaining_candidate)
      collect remaining_candidate
    set remaining_steps to next_remaining_steps
  end

  return ordered_steps
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  for each step in dependencies.keys().sorted()
    let needed_steps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "known step missing"
    for each needed_step in needed_steps.sorted()
      if not dependencies.contains_key(needed_step) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: needed_step)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable ordered: List of Text be []
  let mutable remaining: List of Text be dependencies.keys().sorted()

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable found_step: maybe Text be nothing
    let mutable found_index: maybe Integer be nothing

    for each step, index in remaining.with_index()
      let needed_steps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "known step missing"
      let ready be for each needed_step in needed_steps all ordered.contains(needed_step)
      if ready then
        set found_step to step
        set found_index to index
        break
      end
    end

    match found_index
      when some(index) then
        let ready_step be found_step otherwise crash with "ready step missing"
        set ordered to ordered.append(ready_step)
        set remaining to remaining.without_index(index)
      when nothing then fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end

  return ordered
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  for each step in dependencies.keys().sorted()
    let depends_ons be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "step missing from dependencies"
    for each depends_on in depends_ons.sorted()
      if not dependencies.contains_key(depends_on) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: depends_on)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable remaining be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let mutable ordered: List of Text be []

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing

    for each step in remaining
      let depends_ons be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "step missing from dependencies"
      let ready be for each depends_on in depends_ons all not remaining.contains(depends_on)
      if ready then
        set chosen to step
        break
      end
    end

    match chosen
      when some(selected_step) then
        set ordered to ordered.append(selected_step)
        let position be remaining.index_of(selected_step) otherwise crash with "chosen step missing from remaining"
        set remaining to remaining.without_index(position)
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end

  return ordered
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let all_steps be dependencies.keys().sorted()

  for each step in all_steps
    let needed_steps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "step was missing from its own key set"
    for each depends_on in needed_steps
      if not dependencies.contains_key(depends_on) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: depends_on)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable remaining be all_steps
  let mutable ordered be all_steps.take(0)

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable ready_steps be all_steps.take(0)

    for each step in remaining
      let needed_steps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "remaining step was missing"
      if for each depends_on in needed_steps all ordered.contains(depends_on) then
        set ready_steps to ready_steps.append(step)
      end
    end

    if ready_steps.is_empty() then
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end

    let next_step be ready_steps.first() otherwise crash with "ready step was missing"
    set ordered to ordered.append(next_step)
    set remaining to
      for each step in remaining
      where step is not next_step
      collect step
  end

  return ordered
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let all_steps be dependencies.keys().sorted()

  for each step in all_steps
    let depends_for_step be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "known step missing"
    for each depends_on in depends_for_step
      if not dependencies.contains_key(depends_on) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: depends_on)
      end
    end
  end

  if dependencies.is_empty() then
    return all_steps
  end

  let mutable ordered be all_steps.take(0)
  let mutable completed be all_steps.take(0).to_set()

  repeat until ordered.length() is dependencies.length()
    let mutable ready be all_steps.take(0)

    for each step in all_steps
      if not completed.contains(step) then
        let depends_for_step be dependencies.get(step) otherwise crash with "known step missing"
        let dependencies_done be for each depends_on in depends_for_step all completed.contains(depends_on)
        if dependencies_done then
          set ready to ready.append(step)
        end
      end
    end

    if ready.is_empty() then
      let remaining be for each step in all_steps where not completed.contains(step) collect step
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end

    let next_step be ready.first() otherwise crash with "ready list is empty"
    set ordered to ordered.append(next_step)
    set completed to completed.add(next_step)
  end

  return ordered
end
